full_command: Matt Hooper, wearing his black wetsuit, clings to the edge of a red inflatable raft as he struggles to stay afloat in the dark, choppy ocean. Chief Martin Brody, in his tan uniform, stands on the deck of a nearby boat, holding a bottle of champagne and looking down at Hooper with concern. The sky is overcast, casting a gray hue over the scene. The ocean water is a deep, dark blue, with whitecaps visible on the surface. The mustached man in the gray suit watches from the boat's railing, his expression serious as he observes the tense situation. The boat's deck is cluttered with various items, including a large metal crate and a wooden barrel. The overall atmosphere is one of urgency and danger, with the two men engaged in a high-stakes situation at sea.
